title: Create a directory and its parent folders
summary: Use the -p flag with mkdir to create a directory and any missing parent directories in the path automatically. This prevents errors if the intermediate folders do not exist yet.

steps.explain: Use the --parents flag to create the specified directory and all necessary parent directories.

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY_PATH
placeholders.description: The full path of the directory to create

alternatives.explain: Use the short -p flag for the same effect.
